lineage.strategy: Use a current independent report on newly opened European production capacity and defense demand rather than repeat prior packet evidence.

observations.fact: The Financial Times reports Planet opened a Berlin manufacturing facility capable of producing up to 60 high-resolution Pelican satellites annually, its first production site outside California.
The report says roughly 60% of Planet's business now comes from defense and describes European demand tied to sovereign intelligence needs and German satellite investment plans.

risks.risk: Defense concentration can strengthen demand visibility while increasing procurement, geopolitical and customer-concentration exposure; factory capacity is not the same as utilized profitable output.

unknowns.unknown: The independent report does not establish Berlin utilization, unit economics, margin contribution or exact timing/probability of prospective German program awards.

recommendation: Use the new production-capacity and demand-mix signal as corroborating execution evidence; obtain issuer/contract disclosures before assigning numeric factor or catalyst values.
